description.value: Pho Ho is a Vietnamese noodle soup restaurant located in Chilliwack, BC, offering a cuisine style well-suited to hungry touring cyclists seeking a hot, filling meal. The restaurant's pho-focused menu suggests hearty portions typical of Vietnamese noodle houses. Chilliwack sits along popular Fraser Valley cycling routes, making this a potential restorative stop.
